help.main:
nosub %s - small local dev tools, no account, no subscription

Usage:
  nosub env     stop secrets from reaching git
  nosub schema  export a database schema to Markdown for LLMs
  nosub svg     turn SVG files into clean JSX or Tailwind components
  nosub version print the version

Run "nosub <command> --help" for details.
Use --lang <code> or NOSUB_LANG to change the language (%s).
help.env:
Usage:
  nosub env scan [path]       scan a folder for secrets
    --staged                  only what is staged for commit
    --history                 every commit in the repository
    --json                    machine readable output
  nosub env hook install      block bad commits with a pre-commit hook
    --force                   replace an existing hook
  nosub env hook uninstall    remove the hook
  nosub env example           write .env.example from .env without the values
    --in <file>               source file (default .env)
    --out <file>              target file (default .env.example)
  nosub env gitignore         add .env rules to .gitignore

Silence a false positive with "nosub:allow" on the line, or list paths in .nosubignore.
Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 secrets found, 2 error.
help.schema:
Usage:
  nosub schema <target> [flags]

Targets:
  app.db                      SQLite file
  dump.sql                    pg_dump, mysqldump or sqlite .schema output
  -                           SQL from stdin
  postgres://user:pw@host/db  needs pg_dump in PATH
  mysql://user:pw@host/db     needs mysqldump in PATH

Flags:
  -o <file>                   write to a file instead of stdout
  --compact                   one line per table, no types
  --only <a,b>                only these tables (globs allowed)
  --exclude <a,b>             skip these tables (globs allowed)
help.svg:
Usage:
  nosub svg <file.svg|folder|-> [flags]

Flags:
  -o <path>                   output file, or folder when converting a folder
  --name <Name>               component name (default: from the file name)
  --ts                        TSX with typed props
  --tailwind                  move size, fill, stroke and opacity to classes
  --current-color             replace colors with currentColor
err.hook_exists: a different pre-commit hook already exists, use --force to replace it
scan.tip: Rotate anything real, then remove it. Use "nosub:allow" on the line for false positives.
